checkpoints.title: Stream a bounded reader before adding workers
checkpoints.contract: Fixed-size reads preserve word state and unterminated final lines; at most budget plus one bytes are consumed; ordinary IO failures propagate.

checkpoints.title: Complete verified reference
checkpoints.contract: Complete bounded indexer with deterministic final results and synchronous coordinator-owned per-file progress; initial/result/final snapshots distinguish indexed, oversized, failed, cancelled, unreturned and unsubmitted work. CLI progress uses stderr. Cancellation remains cooperative and no timing guarantee is claimed. Materializes a new standalone copy without changing immutable source.
